example.title: Three-storey modern infill condo with a brick stair tower (Wilshire Montana)
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 2000s three-storey infill condo: pale grey and white stucco boxes with a red-brick stair tower, dark window frames, a flat roof, behind a board fence under the wires. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
